extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court asks whether we lend in Scotland, seeking £45,500 against matrimonial property of around £455,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details provided. To progress matters we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, details of the matrimonial property and how it is held, any dates fixed for proof or other hearings, and client identification and anticipated costs to conclusion. We would also be grateful for confirmation of the instructed firm's details, as the signature and email domain differ. Once we have these, a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication that funding is available or on any particular terms.
